_comment: Defaults for the Jetson Orin Nano Super (8GB unified). setup.sh rewrites the paths; edit config.local.json to override anything without touching this file. contextSize 2048 is the verified-safe default on 8GB - see the memory budget in the README before raising it. ttsOnGpu is false because Pocket TTS on the GPU needs a second CUDA context (~0.6GB plus compute buffers) that does not reliably fit next to Gemma Q4 on this board.
